intent: Technical Brief: Dell Dimension 9150 FPS Drops
detected_fault: FPS drops in games like Crysis and Doom 3 with intermittent frame rate fluctuations
suggested_solution: Upgrade RAM to at least 4GB or more
CPU Upgrade: Consider replacing the Pentium D 950 with a newer CPU, such as a Core 2 Duo E7 or E8 series
GPU Upgrade: Consider upgrading the ATI Radeon HD 4850 to a more modern GPU
